tagline: The engine underneath Browser, used directly from TypeScript.
scenario: Open a page, check the title, follow a link and assert the destination.
notes: Same engine, same auto-waiting, same selector power — Browser is Playwright underneath.
The difference is the surface: keywords a non-programmer can read, versus async TypeScript.
Browser test data, tagging, parallelisation and reporting come from Robot Framework.
Playwright's own API moves faster; Browser exposes it a release or two behind.
